title: File system class design
idea: The file system design is the Composite pattern: an abstract `FileSystemNode` with two kinds, `File` holding bytes and `Directory` holding named children, so callers treat both alike.

analogy.text: A set of nesting boxes. A box may hold loose items or smaller boxes. To weigh a box, you weigh what is inside it.
analogy.breaks: Real boxes have no names; ours do, and each knows its parent.

points: `FileSystemNode` holds the name, the parent link, and the shared methods.
A `File` is a leaf; its size is the bytes it stores.
A `Directory` keeps children in a sorted map, keyed by unique name.
`size()` on a directory asks each child, so the sum is recursive.

edges.label: is-a
edges.caption: A File is a leaf node. It has no children, and its size is its own byte count.

edges.label: is-a
edges.caption: A Directory is also a node, so it can sit inside another directory.

edges.label: has 0..*
edges.caption: A directory holds any number of nodes. This back edge is what makes the pattern Composite.

edges.label: instance of
edges.caption: The root is one Directory object with no parent. Its path is a single slash.

edges.label: has 1
edges.caption: The FileSystem facade owns the root and turns path strings into nodes. That is the next page.

edges.label: throws
edges.caption: Next page: every failure becomes one FsException with a code.

code.title: Composite model
code.caption: Nodes, files and directories with their invariants: valid names, unique children, one parent, no cycles.

walk.text: Build a small tree: root, a docs folder with two files, one file at the top.
Print the tree, the total size, and one file's full path.
Four bad changes, each refused by a model invariant.
Names cannot be empty, contain a slash, or be a dot or two dots.
A path is built by walking parent links up to the root.
Directory size asks every child. A child directory asks its own children.
Adding checks for a second parent, a cycle, and a name clash.

pitfalls: Do not store children in a `HashMap`; its listing order is unspecified.
Do not put a `children` list on `File`; leaves should not pretend to be folders.
Check for cycles when adding a directory, or `size()` recurses until a StackOverflowError.

quiz.q: What is the third `refused:` line FsModel prints?
options: refused: would create a cycle or two parents
quiz.why: The third bad change adds the root under docs. Walking up from docs reaches the root itself, so the cycle check refuses it.

takeaway: One node type, two kinds; directories ask their children.

starters: Why keep a parent link instead of passing the path around?
Should size be cached on each directory instead of computed every time?
How would I add a symbolic link class to this Composite?
